column1: # sysvar ABI table (engine ABI, not game data)
# No 0.290 SDK (YSCom.ycd) is public. This table is the 0.292 one (sha above)
# changed to fit the ysv.ybn of a 0.290 retail build (2010, 477 system ids):
# - _SAVE_PATH (str) at id 52, before _SYSTEM_VERSION (ysv: 52 is a string);
# - each mouse block (_MOUSE_*, _MOUSENUM_*, _CODE_MOUSE_*) has 18 ids, not 20
#   are absent is not known; _*_U3 and _*_D3 are left out here. All variants of
#   a button read the same state, so only ids 94..99 (wheel) depend on this.
